about: Fab stackup templates for `kisi stackups`, `--stackup-preset` and the viewer's “Use a fab stackup” (Prepare PCB) and stackup comparison: per copper layer (top to bottom) its finished thickness, per dielectric (index 0 = below F.Cu) kind, material, pressed thickness, εr and tanδ, and the solder mask. Thicknesses in mm. Every value has a source; values a fab does not publish are marked as assumptions in the dielectric's note. Check that a template still exists in the fab's order form before ordering. More fabs: add a preset with its own sources.

board_thickness.about: When a template fits a board's thickness: the board's stackup (copper and dielectrics, as read) within the fab's board thickness tolerance of the template's nominal thickness.

sources.text: JLCPCB PCB capabilities, board thickness tolerance: ±10 % for 1.0 mm and thicker (1.6 mm: 1.44 … 1.76 mm), ±0.1 mm below 1.0 mm (fetched 2026-11-06).

tolerances.about: Default manufacturing tolerances for the impedance band (`kisi overview --tolerance`, `kisi stackups --tolerance`, the viewer's stackup panel), each ± around the nominal value, and the default target window where a net class has no interface profile. Values named in `estimates` are kisi estimates from the sources, not a fab's guarantee; change them with --tol or in the viewer.

sources.text: dielectric_thickness_pct 10 (estimate): JLCPCB's board thickness tolerance (±10 % for 1.0 mm and thicker, PCB capabilities page) applied to every dielectric; a fab's pressed prepreg thickness depends on the copper it fills and the resin flow.

er_pct 5 (estimate): the spread of published εr for the same JLC core – 4.6 (JITX, 'from Impedance Control Specifications from JLC-PCB') against 4.36 … 4.43 from the NP-155F datasheet by core thickness – is 4 … 5 %; fabs publish no εr tolerance.

copper_pct 10 (estimate): IPC-4562 allows the base foil up to 10 % below its nominal weight (Eurocircuits, Tolerances on copper thickness); inner layers lose more to cleaning and micro-etching (18 µm foil: at least 11.4 µm after processing, IPC-A-600J class 2) and plated outer copper varies more – the trace layer's thickness, symmetric.

width_mm 0.02 (estimate): JLCPCB's track width tolerance is ±20 % with the example 0.08 … 0.12 mm for a 0.1 mm track; kisi takes the example's ±0.02 mm as an absolute etch tolerance for every width (etching removes about the same copper from every edge, so the absolute tolerance hardly grows with the width). Symmetric: each copper edge moves by half of it, gaps shrink as widths grow; no etch factor (trapezoid).

window_pct 10: JLCPCB's standard impedance tolerance ±10 % (±5 % on special request), PCB capabilities page (fetched 2026-11-06). A net class's interface profile, where it has one, gives its own window (z_tol_pct).

sources.text: Layer list, dielectric and copper thicknesses and the pressed board thickness (compressionThickness): JLCPCB's impedance-template data (raw JSON of JLC's impedance-template web API) as captured by gsuberland/jlcpcb_autogenerated_stackups, commit 9c8b685 (2025-05-20); template names as in JLC's order form.

JLCPCB PCB capabilities: FR-4 dielectric constants 7628 prepreg 4.4, 3313 prepreg 4.1, 2116 prepreg 4.16; finished outer copper 1 oz, inner copper 0.5 oz by default; solder mask dielectric constant 3.8.

JLCPCB, User Guide to the JLCPCB Impedance Calculator: laminate Nan Ya NP-155F for 4–8 layers; solder mask 1.2 mil (30.5 µm) on laminate and between traces, 0.6 mil on copper, εr 3.8; inner 0.5 oz copper calculated as 0.6 mil (15.2 µm) – outer 1 oz as 1.6 mil (kisi keeps the finished 35 µm).

Core εr 4.6: JITX library jitxlib.jlcpcb.materials, FR-4 core 'From Impedance Control Specifications from JLC-PCB' (@1 GHz) – a secondary source; alternative (epsilon_r_alt) from the NP-155F datasheet by core thickness as tabulated in gsuberland/jlcpcb_autogenerated_stackups: 0.40 mm 4.36, 0.55 mm 4.41, over 0.70 mm 4.43.
tanδ 0.02 of every dielectric: the NP-155F typical value, not published by JLCPCB.
